hero.subhead: Replace scattered spreadsheets, chats, and paper. Track students, attendance, grades, and payments — built for nurseries, schools, and tutoring centers.

problem.headline: Most schools still run on five disconnected tools
problem.body: Attendance in one place, grades in another, payments by message, pickups by phone. It works — until it does not. EcolnaSpace brings those routines into one shared workspace.
problem.result: Students, attendance, grades, billing, and communication — in one place.
problem.afterLead: Your school's day-to-day, organized into connected modules.
problem.beforeLead: Multiple tools, no shared overview — each team works in its own corner.
problem.beforeSummary: The hidden cost: time lost and information that scatters.

campuses.headline: Multi-campus without separate systems
campuses.body: Run several sites under one organization. Scope staff access by campus when needed, and keep reporting coherent for leadership.
campuses.caption: Organization, campuses, and scoped access in one admin surface.

roles.headline: Dashboards that match each role
roles.body: Admins see operations. Teachers see classes. Parents see what concerns their children. Permissions follow the role — not a shared inbox password.
roles.caption: Role-aware navigation and controlled membership status.

points.one: Permissions tied to role, not shared logins
points.three: Each profile only sees what it needs

daycare.headline: Daycare routines that parents feel
daycare.body: Meals, naps, activities, and verified pickups — so the daily care story is recorded, not reconstructed from memory.
daycare.caption: Daycare logs designed for nurseries and early childhood centers.

points.one: Meals and naps tracked through the day
points.three: A clear daily story for families

audience.headline: Built for private educational establishments
audience.subhead: From early childhood to secondary and tutoring — one product family, shared foundations.

nursery.title: Nurseries
nursery.body: Meals, naps, activities, and pickups — the day documented for families.

school.title: Primary & middle schools
school.body: Enrollment, attendance, grades, and parent messaging in one thread.

high.title: High schools
high.body: Academic tracking, billing, and team coordination without scattered tools.

tutoring.title: Tutoring centers
tutoring.body: Groups, schedules, and payments so you stay focused on teaching.

trust.headline: Trust starts with how data is isolated
trust.body: EcolnaSpace is multi-tenant by design. Each organization works in its own boundary, with role-based access for staff and families.

points.isolation: School data stays within the organization — not mixed with other tenants.
points.roles: Access is granted by membership and permission, including invited accounts that must be activated before sign-in.
points.privacy: We do not sell student data to third parties. Privacy export and erasure tools exist for student records when required.

pricing.headline: Pricing that fits your establishment
pricing.body: Plans depend on size, campuses, and modules. Start with a free organization setup, then talk with us about the right package.

final.headline: Bring your school operations into one calm workspace
final.body: Create your organization in minutes, invite your team, and activate access when you are ready.

footer.blurb: Multi-tenant SaaS for private educational establishments — nurseries, schools, and tutoring centers.
